7c9a9c155dbf6545985c18f084b2f08c4bb3a8be.subject: Choose who receives each update
7c9a9c155dbf6545985c18f084b2f08c4bb3a8be.body: Kyle can match each site login to the right player and email address before sending an update.

56eb9960c33742a64196059cc54d05fd9272dd65.subject: More detail for Kyle
56eb9960c33742a64196059cc54d05fd9272dd65.body: Site updates have space for an explanation, and Kyle can see when people last signed in or used the site.

bbb6a438016c7be82fa15d39ca29bcf71fef60da.subject: Keep older character pictures and share site news
bbb6a438016c7be82fa15d39ca29bcf71fef60da.body: Replacing a player's AI character keeps the previous picture so Kyle can restore it. Kyle can also choose site updates to email to players.

0fa3b733a715e0bc0adca4a30e1300bac20ee05d.subject: Cleaner player suggestions for flyers
0fa3b733a715e0bc0adca4a30e1300bac20ee05d.body: The same player no longer appears more than once in flyer search results because of extra spaces in their name.

dc8a21009258d8c21d9034ec673e07a78069806d.subject: Recap pictures reflect the results
dc8a21009258d8c21d9034ec673e07a78069806d.body: AI pictures are asked to show players' expressions and poses based on how they performed.

0e2f7d730a3833f88fb96c5b7f55f306bcdfd6f8.subject: More believable volleyball pictures
0e2f7d730a3833f88fb96c5b7f55f306bcdfd6f8.body: Volleyball pictures get clearer instructions about the court, net, and players in action.

384c8b8a74ce9bbdf7d8511539fd940dd24f6046.subject: Keep each player's results together
384c8b8a74ce9bbdf7d8511539fd940dd24f6046.body: Names with extra spaces are treated as the same player, helping prevent duplicate players and split stats.

3ac02a2cb813ecc0e89125c512837a8551c7ffc9.subject: Record where you played
3ac02a2cb813ecc0e89125c512837a8551c7ffc9.body: You can add a location when entering a game. Recaps can use it to describe where the games took place.

a5fde00aa081bb6df1c272c489b32c49cb7c5055.subject: Give the recap crown to the right player
a5fde00aa081bb6df1c272c489b32c49cb7c5055.body: The player with the best win percentage gets the crown in recap pictures.

e249a2d36425a7b19e46e34f616b6b64fe8b4ea1.subject: Kyle can see everyone's recaps and flyers
e249a2d36425a7b19e46e34f616b6b64fe8b4ea1.body: The admin page shows all users' recaps, flyers, and picture requests, making it easier to check progress and find problems.

3c8a92bb622d7f8f5360e67c3c2c5c5ad698baab.subject: Save flyers to your phone or computer
3c8a92bb622d7f8f5360e67c3c2c5c5ad698baab.body: Use the flyer save button to open sharing options on your phone or download the picture on a computer.

6d7491bdeb866199a99cfe51cefc506db5acea12.subject: Find your flyers in the menu
6d7491bdeb866199a99cfe51cefc506db5acea12.body: Open Flyers to browse saved flyers and download a picture to share.

8326a2dcc309acfb701503911106b4e3cc84da1d.subject: More realistic character pictures
8326a2dcc309acfb701503911106b4e3cc84da1d.body: New AI character pictures are asked to look like photos rather than cartoons.

2d769d1440e362cf38b1d6a13babdcb31600ff41.subject: Character pictures use your face photo
2d769d1440e362cf38b1d6a13babdcb31600ff41.body: The picture generator uses the player's face photo as a reference for a full-body character.

d9053bfc5cd0fc07cfae5805bd04163c39e88fce.subject: See the whole character picture
d9053bfc5cd0fc07cfae5805bd04163c39e88fce.body: Uploaded character pictures fit inside the preview, including wide photos, without cropping the edges.

49c936cb6fd5c21974ed5541aa8d0a301d060c97.subject: Recap pictures fit on desktop screens
49c936cb6fd5c21974ed5541aa8d0a301d060c97.body: The left edge of recap pictures stays visible when you view them on a computer.

b35521950bab2095ae6eca578e7c292050d5e60b.subject: Avoid made-up faces in group pictures
b35521950bab2095ae6eca578e7c292050d5e60b.body: Players without a photo, signature look, or saved character are left out of group AI pictures.

47774044725512b4cda93c6316aa559b01cd5487.subject: Start another character while one is being made
47774044725512b4cda93c6316aa559b01cd5487.body: You can create a picture for another player or leave the page while the first picture finishes.

f3fd2e9a73009c6f00d3bef59fc9a3a7aacac246.subject: Recap pictures fit better on a Mac
f3fd2e9a73009c6f00d3bef59fc9a3a7aacac246.body: Recap pictures stay within the visible page so the left edge is not cut off.

db9f5507e9728ef4d05603554b391615b47e54ab.subject: Upload your own character picture
db9f5507e9728ef4d05603554b391615b47e54ab.body: You can upload or remove a player's AI character picture for use in recaps and flyers.

f8941058d3b5e4396810f7c1d0fda1177b2b9d3e.subject: Include each player's signature look
f8941058d3b5e4396810f7c1d0fda1177b2b9d3e.body: Character pictures are asked to include all of a player's signature details, including props such as a motorhome.

1c3a472af5a4f2982924fbc9c7c4e634f34c34ea.subject: Player search keeps up with your typing
1c3a472af5a4f2982924fbc9c7c4e634f34c34ea.body: Search results follow the name you are currently typing instead of switching back to an earlier search.

c8ad8067d878a49036334cd470e9cbb952299571.subject: Help group pictures match the right faces
c8ad8067d878a49036334cd470e9cbb952299571.body: Named photo references help the AI keep each player's face with the right person. The iPhone app can also retrieve the roster for photo review.

8ab09245d45b67bee1799a670ae1f2d8c2c76b4b.subject: Keep faces distinct in group pictures
8ab09245d45b67bee1799a670ae1f2d8c2c76b4b.body: Each player's reference photo is linked to their name, with instructions to give players different poses.

c57477bc085a4412d766ce031d71cb699a6d6b4b.subject: Keep browsing while pictures are made
c57477bc085a4412d766ce031d71cb699a6d6b4b.body: Recaps and flyers keep generating after you leave the page. The progress message now explains this.

a1ba06c8d929f3b0b7e9a82639611b93e8aa6c2a.subject: One clear button to edit a player
a1ba06c8d929f3b0b7e9a82639611b93e8aa6c2a.body: A single Edit button next to the player's name opens their details.

d162d56d5d69d08f7e3ff2fea50005f305be172c.subject: Reuse a player's character in different scenes
d162d56d5d69d08f7e3ff2fea50005f305be172c.body: Saved characters focus on the player's appearance and signature look, with scene details added in group pictures.

4acc019d3469e1abb26760ac82a1c13540a49dcb.subject: Fix character picture creation
4acc019d3469e1abb26760ac82a1c13540a49dcb.body: Character pictures use a supported picture size to avoid size-related generation errors.

1e3cd342b4751fb9de43e8201c4f1bea8a61974f.subject: Keep photos when renaming a player
1e3cd342b4751fb9de43e8201c4f1bea8a61974f.body: Changing a player's name keeps their photo and signature look attached to them.

902bd4c59d0a559a3e500dbdf1f421d874b7270b.subject: Save a character for each player
902bd4c59d0a559a3e500dbdf1f421d874b7270b.body: Players can have a reusable AI character for recaps and flyers. Signed-in users can edit players from player pages.

a14961fc0711d9408ad741f73648deb7ed198fc7.subject: Player suggestions for iPhone Vollis entry
a14961fc0711d9408ad741f73648deb7ed198fc7.body: The iPhone app can get the same recently played player list used by the website.

1243f8fa1f0b618476a62f4a20855d7099a57c0e.subject: Connect the iPhone app to site data
1243f8fa1f0b618476a62f4a20855d7099a57c0e.body: The iPhone app can read stats and games and save changes to the same data used by the website.

a04dbf5c14f84f6195843745b31c23c88a1fcb72.subject: More action in recap pictures
a04dbf5c14f84f6195843745b31c23c88a1fcb72.body: AI pictures are asked to show players playing the sport instead of just standing on the court.

1f76807a1461a178d59c49022464f422efea7169.subject: Create recap headlines with the story
1f76807a1461a178d59c49022464f422efea7169.body: The headline and recap are written together, and the headline becomes the recap page title.

39fe5930ace71fba660f8f937301b463fdbf6aaa.subject: Find your recaps in the menu
39fe5930ace71fba660f8f937301b463fdbf6aaa.body: Open AI Recaps to browse your saved recaps. Error pages also give clearer ways to get back to the site.

28df1a165031d0e030f75c27408518ea205efab9.subject: Make session leaders stand out
28df1a165031d0e030f75c27408518ea205efab9.body: Recap pictures are asked to place the leaders at the front, dressed like royalty.

88e574b31e33854a382e8c0bbf280d2a2a19a5d2.subject: Celebrate leaders in recap pictures
88e574b31e33854a382e8c0bbf280d2a2a19a5d2.body: AI pictures are asked to dress session leaders like a king or queen.

4b1e754691edc8b144e4d9ec9d8db49986f9f0c6.subject: Clearer progress when remaking pictures
4b1e754691edc8b144e4d9ec9d8db49986f9f0c6.body: A progress message appears when creating or remaking a recap or flyer, and picture instructions better preserve players' signature looks.

156aa9ca1ee289dd884ccd7698b023a5ab4c350c.subject: Coed pictures match beach volleyball
156aa9ca1ee289dd884ccd7698b023a5ab4c350c.body: Coed recap pictures are asked to show coed beach volleyball.

19826a738187015910f12264b7cd62d537d48e74.subject: Kyle can remove players from the player list
19826a738187015910f12264b7cd62d537d48e74.body: An admin-only delete option is available on the Player List.

3ca094fc1b37bd42d7a905e4e147e058ee21922b.subject: Celebrate the king or queen of the beach
3ca094fc1b37bd42d7a905e4e147e058ee21922b.body: Recap picture instructions give session leaders a beach royalty title.

193e20adc31bcd34e735407fd832bdf7bb16c5b4.subject: Keep signature look descriptions intact
193e20adc31bcd34e735407fd832bdf7bb16c5b4.body: Picture instructions preserve punctuation in each player's signature look.

40f70048b2c954275612940b97c2f4d2c29653da.subject: Start recaps with the latest day's games
40f70048b2c954275612940b97c2f4d2c29653da.body: The latest day is selected by default, with that day's full game list shown first.

9dd57f1e3f4f4dc7b61804ffb2aef815dc6f51d4.subject: Keep the Add menu visible on phones
9dd57f1e3f4f4dc7b61804ffb2aef815dc6f51d4.body: The Add menu stays on-screen when there is not enough room beside the button.

f61efb7b8acbfeb8a96f3fbe8693897ef2d26fc4.subject: Show picture progress promptly on phones
f61efb7b8acbfeb8a96f3fbe8693897ef2d26fc4.body: The generating message appears before the phone moves to the next page.

4cf29a21cbd8643ea16e2d75e269dab68d8cc1fe.subject: Label players in recap pictures
4cf29a21cbd8643ea16e2d75e269dab68d8cc1fe.body: AI pictures are asked to include each player's name and stats. Starting generation no longer needs an extra confirmation popup.

be20a6aa58fde3b4e5433d7a4dd369c7c9e5e905.subject: Show signature looks as picture details
be20a6aa58fde3b4e5433d7a4dd369c7c9e5e905.body: Picture instructions describe signature looks as things to draw. At this stage, mobile users were also shown a reminder to wait.

a5e10ef56170a8098c41bad0ab858c32311af1bc.subject: Keep extra words out of AI pictures
a5e10ef56170a8098c41bad0ab858c32311af1bc.body: Picture instructions ask for names and stats as text, with other details shown visually.

0e76b306b718b23420cb6a05a89358dd47c755e2.subject: Create group recap pictures in one step
0e76b306b718b23420cb6a05a89358dd47c755e2.body: Recaps request one group picture without making separate portraits first.

fe243d4543ebfdc73b4bcbcddeec35d0ac53e9a6.subject: Draw signature looks instead of quoting them
fe243d4543ebfdc73b4bcbcddeec35d0ac53e9a6.body: Signature look descriptions are presented as picture instructions rather than text to print on the image.

89ab7fb524df05c4a33d16b9ebe164a7fec2da62.subject: Clearer instructions for player pictures
89ab7fb524df05c4a33d16b9ebe164a7fec2da62.body: Face references, stats, and signature looks are described separately to help the AI follow them.

3ab240bc065efbb7d3cd7ae595bffbba82c689a0.subject: Recover interrupted picture requests
3ab240bc065efbb7d3cd7ae595bffbba82c689a0.body: Background picture requests can be picked up again after the service restarts.

f1942e62cf0a5b2920c8729a9971f9d6164c48f8.subject: Explain the wait while pictures are made
f1942e62cf0a5b2920c8729a9971f9d6164c48f8.body: An earlier progress message asked users to keep the page open while pictures finished.

82bcb381e037908422116479aa4599266edf7579.subject: Make signature looks visual
82bcb381e037908422116479aa4599266edf7579.body: AI pictures are asked to draw signature details rather than write them on the picture.

5855c4c7110509455269117b717749cf7a3c1642.subject: Find roster players when adding a game
5855c4c7110509455269117b717749cf7a3c1642.body: Player suggestions include people on the roster.

1ef1123963745cb506aedbd5b11ade4184bfd357.subject: Save player details and close the window
1ef1123963745cb506aedbd5b11ade4184bfd357.body: The player editor has a clearer Save and close button.

f4b1e1a13660a2fc5325b26181d3771a5c1c4b5b.subject: Nicknames save correctly
f4b1e1a13660a2fc5325b26181d3771a5c1c4b5b.body: A nickname entered in the player editor is kept after saving.

172a59e4794ae1f0fc60aaf9c204d6ad483390a4.subject: Edit nicknames with player photos
172a59e4794ae1f0fc60aaf9c204d6ad483390a4.body: The player photo editor includes a nickname field.

7321bd309ccc03f258aaa6d70d9e25cf85fd4205.subject: Use nicknames in recap pictures
7321bd309ccc03f258aaa6d70d9e25cf85fd4205.body: AI pictures are asked to label players with their nickname and session stats.

c87ad4d8ca67b25cfa8ff3618b6a9126aa9b9ca7.subject: Give slow picture requests more time
c87ad4d8ca67b25cfa8ff3618b6a9126aa9b9ca7.body: Picture creation waits longer and retries temporary failures.

a8272658fee44ead173c281cfab98fd49aa80974.subject: Use signature looks without a face photo
a8272658fee44ead173c281cfab98fd49aa80974.body: Players with a signature look can be included in individual AI pictures even without a photo.

451b18240f79a408894a5904eb4d55ec8a274d8c.subject: Skip separate portraits when making a recap
451b18240f79a408894a5904eb4d55ec8a274d8c.body: Recaps make one group picture, removing the wait for individual player pictures first.

4cfccd709dcb1e6da37689599600c14925ce2fe7.subject: Help diagnose background service problems
4cfccd709dcb1e6da37689599600c14925ce2fe7.body: Startup logging makes it easier to check why automatic recap processing has not started.

5672384ef272681cf168bef467a0c6537c1b3d03.subject: Fix automatic recap service startup
5672384ef272681cf168bef467a0c6537c1b3d03.body: The background service can find its files when the hosting account name uses capital letters.

c0c6256ce19987c3255af3aacda009b6d59de5b4.subject: Help background picture work start reliably
c0c6256ce19987c3255af3aacda009b6d59de5b4.body: The service uses the full location of its startup file so it can be found reliably.

cbf629d812e95da818de925f9277ec6141a86be0.subject: Fix background service getting stuck at startup
cbf629d812e95da818de925f9277ec6141a86be0.body: The automatic picture service can get past its Starting state.

e09041ad97f024568ad625e927fa871a5e1ddf92.subject: Review players before making a recap or flyer
e09041ad97f024568ad625e927fa871a5e1ddf92.body: Check player photos and signature looks before starting generation.

e83c7966dd4d91f49b9a9cedc4a66f329788d9ee.subject: Fix automatic recap startup and sharing links
e83c7966dd4d91f49b9a9cedc4a66f329788d9ee.body: The background recap service starts correctly, and shared links use the site's address.

a8ce4af5157c01295fd366e62e3b526465739b2d.subject: Reduce the wait for flyers
a8ce4af5157c01295fd366e62e3b526465739b2d.body: Flyers use uploaded face photos directly instead of creating a separate character for every player first.

b2ac3cf0d8bbcc2728a9bb3deba6b5c134aa1619.subject: Use the configured AI service for recaps
b2ac3cf0d8bbcc2728a9bb3deba6b5c134aa1619.body: When OpenAI is set up, it is the preferred service for recap writing and pictures.

a90963e87832d2c77b81e10715aa0bb04a270cd6.subject: See point differences in more recaps
a90963e87832d2c77b81e10715aa0bb04a270cd6.body: Vollis and other-game recaps show how many more or fewer points each player scored than their opponents.

fc0ba8c8f6c71156a6f78cf808b5139fda48b5c8.subject: Show a player's photo when sharing their page
fc0ba8c8f6c71156a6f78cf808b5139fda48b5c8.body: Shared player links can include the player's face photo in the preview.

40b2a0555ad814b7da7649177fc84b34f1e2dc09.subject: See everyone in today's stats
40b2a0555ad814b7da7649177fc84b34f1e2dc09.body: Today's stats tables show all players instead of hiding everyone after the first five.

5e41f89002f914aed04e99795e7e23a6cd10ec8e.subject: Kyle can browse all AI flyers
5e41f89002f914aed04e99795e7e23a6cd10ec8e.body: The admin flyer page lists flyers with their pictures and the instructions used to create them.

a441a454aacb72a8d991cd660126725887bd23f6.subject: Skip pictures without a player reference
a441a454aacb72a8d991cd660126725887bd23f6.body: Players with neither a face photo nor a signature look are left out of AI illustrations.

7354b0d6b4661336698d7c0b1d065dfd2747267b.subject: Simpler doubles game entry
7354b0d6b4661336698d7c0b1d065dfd2747267b.body: Game-day photo uploads were removed from the doubles score form.

a97c3a96420e382f4428178b8eadf37586511782.subject: Guidance for future picture changes
a97c3a96420e382f4428178b8eadf37586511782.body: Development guidance asks for players' signature looks to stand out in AI pictures.

db039cd44e54a200b2ea16f5a003ad58323219f2.subject: Upload larger player photos
db039cd44e54a200b2ea16f5a003ad58323219f2.body: Photo uploads can be up to 10 MB, with stored pictures compressed to save space.

9e8336a36e816cf1881df23a40afc3833ee67ee5.subject: Choose game-day photos from your library
9e8336a36e816cf1881df23a40afc3833ee67ee5.body: The game-day photo picker allowed choosing an existing photo from your library.

f8323c916d718fb16ec6da440072f122a897951a.subject: Add game-day photos beside player names
f8323c916d718fb16ec6da440072f122a897951a.body: Game-day photo controls were placed beside names in Today's Stats.
